page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfr7.24xlarge is a memory-optimized cloud instance provisioned with 96 dedicated vCPUs operating on an Intel Xeon 8369HB processor at 3.3 GHz. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via a KVM hypervisor, this host supplies 768.0 GB of system memory, yielding an 8.0 GB per vCPU ratio. Network connectivity features a 32 Gbps baseline bandwidth, while the instance carries zero complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

The server contains no local ephemeral storage, requiring external network-attached volumes for data persistence. This architecture trades local disk IOPS performance for centralized storage flexibility and scaling. Empirical benchmark telemetry for this instance is unavailable in the dataset, precluding direct hardware throughput benchmarking.

Given its 768.0 GB RAM capacity and 96 dedicated compute cores, the server is suitable for enterprise workloads requiring substantial memory density, including large-scale in-memory databases, distributed caching layers, enterprise resource planning systems, and batch data processing.
